mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment exceeding 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
